name: Scare
levelText: antipaladin 2, arcanist 2, bard 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, skald 2, sorcerer 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2, wizard 2
componentsText: V, S, M (a bone from an undead creature)
target: Target: one living creature per three levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
duration: 1 round/level or 1 round; see text for cause fear
description: This spell functions like cause fear, except that it causes all targeted creatures of less than 6 HD to become frightened.
